goal: Start and use an accepted My Tasks app inside Software work, retain items across close/reload/Stop/restart, and explicitly open its accepted My Week child without changing accepted work.

assertions.name: A valid paired-online key still cannot launch locally; unknown Start command fields are rejected without changing launch state.
Only a visible Start creates the product-managed trusted runtime, pinned to accepted ZIP/source and a separate origin.
assertions.message: App is running. Closing this window leaves it running; Stop app ends this session and keeps browser data.
assertions.title: My Tasks

assertions.name: A second Studio attempt on the same data/address fails its bind without interrupting or relabelling the original running app.
Actual Focus/Back controls keep Stop/Check reachable at360x800 and360x420; measured wide app viewport and existing iframe preserve saved items and client draft/count during resize.
A temporary aborted status GET keeps the same iframe and unsubmitted app draft; explicit real status inspection recovers without POST or process recreation.
assertions.transport: One browser status GET was deliberately aborted while the real host/runtime stayed healthy.

assertions.name: Close/reopen and Studio reload retain the same process/start identity, saved items and source without another POST or preparation.
Actual embedded storage works while parent DOM/storage/top navigation and Studio HttpOnly cookie reads are blocked.
Explicit Stop awaits owned exit; a later explicit Start uses the same saved-data origin and retained items.
After SIGTERM, an old-tab status GET is rejected403; explicit reconnect uses only GET, preserves the unsent draft, does not navigate, POST or start an app/model.
Studio SIGTERM cleans up the owned app; restart stays stopped until explicit Start and preserves its origin/items.
After SIGKILL, an old-tab status GET is rejected403; explicit reconnect uses only GET, preserves the unsent draft, does not navigate, POST or start an app/model.
Studio SIGKILL cleans up the owned app; restart stays stopped until explicit Start and preserves its origin/items.
Explicit Stop(parent) then Start(accepted child) retains the lineage origin, existing tasks and continued edits without changing accepted parent work.
An occupied reserved origin/unrelated HTTP200 fails visibly without changing port, attaching to it or killing its owner; explicit retry succeeds after the owned blocker closes.
Accepted task records, ZIPs, source, model-call counts and original stopped fixtures remain unchanged; only explicit launch controls POST.

limitations: This launches copied, previously native-generated accepted work; it is not fresh inference or arbitrary model-written server execution.
Fixed trusted React browser runtime executes exact accepted client Page code; this is not the packaged Next server.
Existing matching dependencies are reused; no online installation, native OS or physical handset/voice pass.
